message.content:
Here’s a classic list of ingredients you’ll need to bake a delicious chocolate cake:

| Ingredient | Quantity | Notes |
|------------|----------|-------|
| All‑purpose flour | 1 ¾ cups (220 g) | Sifted for a lighter crumb |
| Granulated sugar | 2 cups (400 g) | For sweetness and structure |
| Unsweetened cocoa powder | ¾ cup (75 g) | Use a high‑quality Dutch‑process for richer flavor |
| Baking soda | 1 ½ teaspoons | Helps the batter rise |
| Baking powder | 1 ½ teaspoons | Adds lift if you prefer a slightly lighter texture |
| Salt | 1 ½ teaspoons | Balances sweetness |
| Buttermilk (or whole milk + 1 tsp vinegar) | 1 cup (240 ml) | Adds moisture and acidity |
| Eggs | 2 large | Room temperature for better emulsification |
| Vegetable oil | ½ cup (120 ml) | Keeps the cake moist |
| Vanilla extract | 2 teaspoons | Enhances overall flavor |
| Boiling water | 1 cup (240 ml) | Dissolves cocoa and creates a tender crumb |
| Optional: 1 cup (240 ml) hot coffee | 1 cup (240 ml) | Intensifies chocolate flavor |

**Optional extras for extra richness:**
- ½ cup (120 ml) heavy cream or sour cream (adds moisture)
- ¼ cup (30 g) melted dark chocolate (for deeper flavor)
- 1 tsp instant espresso powder (boosts chocolate depth)

**Optional frosting:**
- ½ cup (115 g) unsalted butter, softened
- 3 cups (360 g) powdered sugar
- ¼ cup (25 g) unsweetened cocoa powder
- ¼ cup (60 ml) milk or heavy cream
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

Feel free to adjust quantities based on your preferred cake size or dietary needs. Happy baking!
